candidates.instruction: Replace the 32-bit `counter` with an 8-bit counter split into low and high nibbles: increment the low nibble every non-reset cycle and increment the high nibble only when the old low nibble is `4'hF`, with natural nibble wraparound. Keep synchronous reset to zero and retain the registered `pwm_out <= (counter < duty)` behavior using the old counter value each cycle. Preserve the exact 256-cycle sequence and reset behavior; promote only if the unchanged verification gates pass and routed LUT use is strictly below 7 while timing remains feasible.
